Winterstate Trailer Voice

I've said it many times, I love game trailers. Working with some fantastic production houses, the end result is always spectacular.

Check out the video

It was a lot of fun to provide a different voice style for Winterstate's trailer. They asked me for an army-style American accent and, although it's not my most common voiceover style, it's a voice I have plenty of experience with. If you're interested in this kind of voiceover, you should check out my game trailer voiceovers and for more examples of my American voiceovers, check out my A Team Voice and my Lifeless game trailer.

What is Winterstate?


Knuckle Sam needs YOU - download now to reclaim the nation! Take command of a convoy of deadly fighting vehicles, as you hit the road with the legendary Knuckle Sam and his band of Runners. Under the banner of Sam's Winterstate you’ll build a powerful force, repel the raiders and take the fight back to The Code - a mysterious, deadly threat emerging from the West.

Get in touch

Do you have a game waiting to finish it with a trailer? Do you need a voice track similar to this Winterstate Trailer Voice ? Please get in touch. To make the process even easier, just let me know the intended usage of the production and I can quote you more accurately. Do send a sample of the script and I'll send you a short audition. Check to see if my voice is right for your show or project. Please do get in touch today.
